name: Mike's Metal Works
old_description: Founded by Mike Winters in 1986, we specialize in copper, zinc, lead and stainless steel. Three generations of knowledge, time tested tools and machinery and our traditional, small operation ensures the very best quality, materials and service that money can buy. This traditional approach to the techniques translates to the customer experience as well. Our small operation ensures an unmatched product and unrivaled customer satisfaction.
about:
Mike's Metal Works operates from Bozeman, Montana, where founder Mike Winters established the shop in 1986 after years in roofing and sheet metal. The business draws on three generations of metalworking knowledge; a shop anvil passed down from Winters' grandfather has been in the family for over a century.

The company produces custom architectural metalwork, specializing in copper, zinc, lead, and stainless steel roofing systems built with traditional techniques such as double-lock standing seam, flat seam, and soldered joints. A full-service fabrication shop houses shears, brakes, rolls, turners, punches, a forge, welders, plasma cutting, roll forming, and an English wheel, enabling production of cupolas, gutters, range hoods, and other custom pieces. Welding capabilities cover copper, steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and exotic alloys. The shop runs without computer-aided layout, relying on trammels, dividers, and rules, and employs only two or three workers to maintain personal oversight.

Customers include architectural metal firms and roofing contractors on projects such as the Sun Valley Amphitheater copper roof, where Zahner Company's senior vice president praised the crew's hand-worked custom panels and a mobile positioning device that boosted ergonomic efficiency. The firm's work has been featured in Cowboys and Indians magazine.

Winters emphasizes a traditional, small-scale approach as the differentiator: time-tested hand tools, multi-generational expertise, and a lean crew ensure quality and responsive service on each project.
